definitions.explanation: A stag beetle of cooler, higher-elevation forests, recognizable by the ear-like flanges at the back of the male's head.

examples.japanese: ミヤマクワガタ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: The deep-mountain stag beetle lives in cool mountains.
The deep-mountain stag beetle has flanges on its head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{標高|ひょうこう}→標高：13175_hyoukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ミヤマクワガタ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採集|さいしゅう}→採集：00355_saishuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I collected a deep-mountain stag beetle at a high altitude.

notes:
A stag beetle of cooler, higher-elevation forests — {深山|みやま} means 'deep mountains.' The male is distinguished by the ear-like flanges at the back of its head.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦オオクワガタ→オオクワガタ：30000_ookuwagata⟧: giant stag beetle — a lowland species with a glossy black body
- ⟦ノコギリクワガタ→ノコギリクワガタ：30001_nokogirikuwagata⟧: sawtooth stag beetle — long, curved, saw-like jaws
